name: Geronimo Stilton in the Kingdom of Fantasy: The Videogame
source: Geronimo Stilton is the editor-in-chief of the most widely read newspaper of New Mouse City: The Rodent's Gazette. Join him on a fantastic adventure as he discovers a doorway to an enchanted realm and is whisked off on a thrilling quest to save the Fairy Queen.
